human_tolerance.notes: Very common in scrub and other open country, including cultivated land and urban centres, where it feeds on grain alongside feral pigeons; a resident breeder, it may raise two or three broods a year.

phases.name: territorial
phases.note: The species is resident, but the available sources do not establish a breeding calendar for this population. The year-round territorial phase is a neutral schema-required placeholder, not a claim about breeding months.

vocalizations.description: A soft, rising, cooing call repeated by the pair from a low perch or the ground, more insistent in the breeding season.
A short, hard, clipped note given when flushed.

taxonomy.note: GBIF Backbone Taxonomy gives Aves Columbiformes Columbidae and the authorship on the matched name; the Wikidata item confirms the English common name.

external.note: GBIF usage key 2495858 and iNaturalist taxon id 3580 as matched by the GBIF backbone and the iNaturalist taxa API; Wikidata Q1386698 carries the same identifiers.

common_names.note: English common name from Wikidata; Portuguese name from the article's interlanguage links.

conservation.note: Wikidata P141 = least concern for Ruddy ground-dove.

range.note: Wikipedia: a resident breeder from Mexico south to Brazil, Peru and Paraguay, and northern Argentina, plus Trinidad and Tobago; occasional winter visitors reach the southwestern United States.

traits.body_plan.note: A perching passerine or parrot; biped_winged mesh.

traits.limb_count.note: Two legs; wings are not counted as limbs.

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Authored params for the shared perching-songbird program; Walk is the declared ground locomotion, so the model walks rather than hops.

traits.metamorphosis.note: None; the young hatch as fledged nestlings.

traits.senses.note: Colour vision in all birds; hearing and olfaction values are authored judgement, as no open source quantifies them here.

traits.nest_type.note: Food weights follow traits.diet; the cup nest of sticks in a tree from Wikipedia; the perch weight is judgement.

traits.mass_kg.note: AVONET Mass 46.04 g; Wikipedia gives 35-56 g.

traits.length_m.note: Wikipedia: 'small short-tailed pigeons, 17 cm long' and 'it measures 12-18 cm in length'; 0.17 m is the stated typical length.

traits.diet.note: EltonTraits Diet-Seed 90, Diet-Inv 10; Wikipedia confirms it feeds on grain.

traits.social.note: Wikipedia: a resident breeder; group_size [1, 2] is judgement for a pair.

traits.activity_pattern.note: EltonTraits Nocturnal 0 (diurnal); Ruddy ground-dove describes daytime activity.

traits.defense.note: Authored: flies to cover when disturbed.

traits.wariness.note: Authored. Bolder than the thrush because it feeds in the open in streets, but it still flushes readily; set mid-range.

habitat.shelter_tag.note: Authored: roosts in dense vegetation or a cavity.

habitat.resources.note: Food weights follow traits.diet; the cup nest of sticks in a tree from Wikipedia; the perch weight is judgement.

habitat.human_tolerance.note: Wikipedia: very common in scrub, cultivated land and urban centres, feeding on grain alongside feral pigeons.

seasonal.strategy.note: A year-round resident of subtropical Brazil with no migration or dormancy described.

seasonal.phases.note: The species is resident, but the available sources do not establish a breeding calendar for this population. The year-round territorial phase is a neutral schema-required placeholder, not a claim about breeding months.

seasonal.life_stages.note: Only sourced life-stage structure and egg incubation are retained; unsupported juvenile timing is omitted.

behavior.note: The primary field study observed Columbina talpacoti feeding on soil, grass and paving, with seeds the preferred food. This species-local program changes the shared songbird ground hop to walking; gait is a simulation choice, not a measured step-cycle.

look.note: Colours from the Wikipedia description (rufous upperparts, paler brown underparts, cinnamon and black underwings, black-edged tail, red eye); proportions authored for a small short-tailed dove.

traits.mass_range_kg.note: AVONET Mass 46.04 g; Wikipedia gives 35-56 g.

vocalizations.song.note: Call description from the Ruddy ground-dove article; months, time windows, cooldowns and loudness are authored judgement, as no open source quantifies them.

vocalizations.alarm.note: Call description from the Ruddy ground-dove article; months, time windows, cooldowns and loudness are authored judgement, as no open source quantifies them.

traits.lifespan_y.note: A low-precision simulation value for a small dove, modeled near the 4-5 year wild values used for comparable columbids in this repository. No species-specific estimate was found; this is not a measured lifespan.
